## Details

<a id="title_show"></a>
### [`title_show`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_5718.asm#L6) `$5718`

*routine*

Title code of the KTITLE file: copies the colours to $d800 and shows the title picture in VIC bank 1. The loader calls it before it loads KMAIN.

- **Calls:** [`title_copy_colours`](leftover_5718.md#title_copy_colours)
- **Reads:** [`CI2DDRA`](../../memory-map.md#CI2DDRA), [`CI2PRA`](../../memory-map.md#CI2PRA), [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`SCROLX`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLX), [`VMCSB`](../../memory-map.md#VMCSB)
- **Writes:** [`SCROLY`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLY), [`EXTCOL`](../../memory-map.md#EXTCOL), [`BGCOL0`](../../memory-map.md#BGCOL0), [`VMCSB`](../../memory-map.md#VMCSB), [`CI2DDRA`](../../memory-map.md#CI2DDRA), [`CI2PRA`](../../memory-map.md#CI2PRA), [`SCROLX`](../../memory-map.md#SCROLX)

<a id="title_copy_colours"></a>
### [`title_copy_colours`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_5718.asm#L37) `$5760`

*routine*

Copies the 1000 bytes at title_colour_ram to the colour RAM at $d800, in 4 blocks of 250 bytes.

- **Writes:** [`plot_vector`](../../memory-map.md#plot_vector), [`work_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#work_ptr)
- **Refers to:** [`title_colour_ram`](../data/title_picture.md#title_colour_ram)
